name: magify.design
summary: AI product-design platform that generates PRDs, UI designs and code from text prompts and sketches.
description: A web platform that generates PRDs, designs and front-end code based on your design system, driven by text prompts and sketches. Existing designs can be edited with prompts or by moving elements while the AI works out the precise layout, and work imports from and exports to Figma. Access is currently early access for design partners.
contains: generates PRDs, designs and code from text prompts and sketches
imports and exports designs with Figma
AI-assisted precise layout for freely moved elements
